original_proposal.cue_name: Upper-right outer corner of the top front wooden plank/rim

original_proposal.target_identity: Front-facing wooden bin/pallet structure, specifically its uppermost horizontal wooden front plank; green equipment is background.
original_proposal.before_visible_evidence: The wood front face and both adjoining outer boundaries are directly visible. This is a visible structural board-end junction rather than lettering or a selected mask-positive point.
original_proposal.ambiguity: Board edge is rounded/blurred over a few pixels and the upper contour has a slight slope. The proposed point denotes this region, not exact material membership or a calibrated cuboid vertex.
original_proposal.uncertainty_reason: Four-pixel halfwidth covers blur, rounding and uncertainty of the meeting of upper and right contours.
original_proposal.alternative_interpretation: Individual top-front board corner; not proven whole-bin top cuboid corner or an independently named native8 reference.
original_proposal.uncertainty_semantics: Half-open native XYXY region representing proposed contour-junction/localization uncertainty; not all pixels asserted to be wood or corner.
